notes.title: 🎉✨ "SORREL COFFEE" IS OUT ON STEAM! ✨☕
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/42a1a9c6d1408bbaf5aa5f1c7dfafff33aadf07c.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]💚 Friends, we did it![/b][/h3]

Our visual novel "Sorrel Coffee" has finally been released - and now it's yours 🎉 Months of development, dozens of scenes redrawn, hundreds of lines of code and countless cups of real coffee - we're happy to present you the game we've been dreaming of.

And it's already waiting for you on Steam - with a 15% discount on the occasion of the release! 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511020/I_drink_Sorrel_Coffee_to_reboot_reality_but_Im_being_hunted_by_Monster_Girls_and_armed_agents/

[i]You find yourself in a strange cafe where everyone insists that you have a cup of sorrel coffee. But beware: every sip resets reality, and you find yourself in a new world full of mystery and danger. Who are you? Why has your memory been erased? And why are monster girls and armed agents after you? 👀[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/317573b384330f5e552ffe227d6867dd2b164e84.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/f891a53affa42f062869486b0a78acaf6ebbd750.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/88bc3a8c7aefa39153962fb20bc3749affd1c7ef.png[/img]
[b]🌟 At Sorrel Coffee, you'll be treated to:
[/b]
- 🧩 A strange reality for you to uncover
- 💋 4 unique heroines - strange, dangerous, alluring
- 🎭 6 endings: from romantic to absolutely insane
- 🔊 Nice voice-over in Russian - atmospheric and lively
- 🍑 6 animated h-scenes - in free DLC (no need to pay!)

Choose the path, uncover the truth and decide - whether it's worth drinking Stubble Coffee to start all over again...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/f0997d3dbecf47a4c168e9d883247bb83d4cd186.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511020/I_drink_Sorrel_Coffee_to_reboot_reality_but_Im_being_hunted_by_Monster_Girls_and_armed_agents/

In honor of the game's release, we've prepared a gift for you - 15% off Sorrel Coffee on Steam in the first days after the release! 

A great reason to dive into the mysterious world at a better price 💸

❤️ Thank you for being with us all this time

Your interest, support and every kind word helped us go from idea to release.

Now it's your turn. Come to our cafe, make your choice... and try not to lose yourself in new realities.

See you in the game ☕🌌

notes.title: The last devlog and more news about the release postponement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/ff2d45f1ee77a2a739b1543d7f99e8c8728ae1bc.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Hello dear friends, we are almost there - and we want to share some important news:[/b][/h3]

✅ [b][u]The game has passed Steam moderation![/u][/b] 🎉 And not only that: we've had time to test it through Steam, added achievements and put the finishing touches. Everything is ready for launch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511020/YA_pyu_SHHavelevyj_Kofe_chtoby_perezapustit_realnost_no_na_menya_oxotyatsya_MonstroDevushki_i_vooruzhennye_agenty/

📆 [b][u]The release has been postponed to June 6th... [/u][/b]but this is definitely the date - the last deadline! After a few minor delays related to the final stages of publishing, we have decided on the final date. On June 6th, Sorrel Coffee will be available on Steam. No postponements. No waiting. Just you, your choices and a cup of coffee that will change reality.

[h3][b]🎯 Mini-devlog from the development team: [/b][/h3]
✅ Passed Steam moderation 
✅ Tested the game with Steam 
✅ Added in-game achievements 
✅ As before, all DLC (artbook, wallpapers, 18+ content) are fully ready 
✅ Localizations, text, voice-over in Russian - all collected in one seamless experience

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/be7f0444fd044f4cae1d7e10e66b2b778df8a941.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/c3deb12c7645652d184ceb09b9fbb950e99de18d.png[/img]

[b]💚 Thank you for your patience and interest in our project[/b]. You helped us grow, develop the game and believe in it even in the most difficult moments. Now there's just a little bit left - and you will be able to make your choice, meet mysterious girls and find out what's behind a cup of Sorrel Coffee.

⏳ See you on June 6th 💗 Add the game to your wishlist so you don't miss the release:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511020/YA_pyu_SHHavelevyj_Kofe_chtoby_perezapustit_realnost_no_na_menya_oxotyatsya_MonstroDevushki_i_vooruzhennye_agenty/

notes.title: 🍵Devlog: What's new in the world of Sorrel Coffee? 🌱
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/74dd3ca4c1d0c5052059c6e6269540160dcdf4d4.jpg[/img]
[h3]🍵[b]Devlog: What's new in the world of Sorrel Coffee?[/b] 🌱[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511020/I_drink_Sorrel_Coffee_to_reboot_reality_but_Im_being_hunted_by_Monster_Girls_and_armed_agents/
It's time to share the latest news about our game development. Every day we are getting closer to the moment when you will be able to fully immerse yourself in our mysterious world. And here's what happened during this time:

[b]✅ The entire script has been contributed to the code![/b]
The story is now part of the game, and every line of dialog is ready to tell you its secrets.

[b]⏳ Work on the art continues:[/b]
Our artist is tirelessly creating stunning images for each scene. Today we want to show you some sketches with our favorite Kiki!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/8a61f9f8b878da28481605f8dc39a57ab7ff00c2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/1549d28d7f803f936ff74ccfe63513e0ecef0e59.jpg[/img]
[b]✨ Added interactivity in some scenes:[/b]
We decided to make the game even more interesting and added additional interaction elements. Now some scenes not only tell a story, but also allow you to actively influence what is happening. This should dilute the narrative and make it more exciting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/6feb27ebae5a6e587bd623ef38ad73b6b3a6f287.jpg[/img]
[b]📅 The second update of the demo is coming![/b]
In the next demo update you will be able to dive into other story branches and learn more about the mysteries of our world. You'll soon be able to check out these changes for yourself - stay tuned!

Thanks to everyone who supports us with their attention and feedback. Your interest gives us the strength to move forward. See you in the next devlog! ☕
